title: Ken Trapp Jr. on Finding His Calling and the Power of Connection
summary: Learn how Ken's initial curiosity at a college career fair became a lifelong pursuit of delivering impact for patients, families and physicians.
body_markdown:
When Kenneth “Ken” Trapp Jr. talks about leadership, he doesn’t begin with business strategy or goals. He starts with people – their stories, motivations and what helps them grow. For Ken, success is measured not only by outcomes but by the connections made along the way.


That perspective has defined his career in biopharma, a journey that began unexpectedly as a college student at Michigan State University. Attending a summer program that included presentations from Fortune 500 companies, Ken found his spark when an industry veteran explained how their work transformed patients’ lives.


“I didn’t know a career in biotech sales existed,” he says. “But hearing how those medicines could make a meaningful difference excited me – and I knew I wanted to be part of that.”


That excitement became a calling. After graduating, Ken spent nearly two decades in sales and management before moving into marketing and market access. Five years ago, he joined BioMarin and now serves as Head of Sales for the Metabolic Conditions Business Unit.


Ken recently shared reflections for our employee profile series, The DNA of BioMarin, which draws inspiration from the four chemical bases of DNA – **A** (adenine), **T** (thymine), **C** (cytosine) and **G** (guanine) – through a conversation around **A** spiration, **C** onnection, **G** ratitude and **T** ranslation.


Read more about Ken’s journey, how leadership rooted in connection shapes his approach, and how his gratitude continues to motivate his work and personal growth.
